records.text: Candace Owens said Charlie Kirk was scheduled to speak at Charis Bible College on September 11 and then meet Erika Kirk at Colorado State University, but no security plan had been made for the Charis event.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Charlie was supposed to be in Colorado the next day, right, on September 11th, immediately following UVU, his next event, which was for some reason barely publicized, was to take place at Charis Bible College, September 11th. ... We also broke the story that a security plan was not put in place for that event, which is remarkable. ... Now, after Charis Bible, Charlie was due to meet up, as we learned, with Erika at Colorado State University, which is situated at Fort Collins. ... Erika confirmed that in her sit down with Jesse Watters

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms Kirk was scheduled at Charis Bible College on September 11 and at Colorado State University on September 18. The complaint context confirms Harpole said he personally had not coordinated with Charis or Woodland Park police because he had not been told of the visit. That does not establish that no security plan of any kind existed, and reviewed sources did not independently confirm the planned Erika meeting.
